name: MJ Widget Set
description: The full MJ set: 25 desktop widgets for your wallpaper, ported from end4-pC (illogical-impulse) with live Ryoku theming, weather and audio - the set was previously published as Awe.

items.name: mjw-calendar
items.summary: Month calendar tile with size presets, today ring and week strip from the illogical-impulse desktop.

items.name: mjw-clock
items.summary: Desktop clock with the illogical-impulse faces: analog cookie, digital, and pixel dot-matrix, tinted by your live theme.

items.name: mjw-image
items.summary: Your photo in any of 34 Material shapes, drop-replaceable and resizeable — the illogical-impulse image tile.

items.name: mjw-image-converter
items.summary: Drop images on the tile to convert them (png/jpg/webp/avif/bmp/tiff) or merge a stack into one PDF, beside the source.

items.name: mjw-media
items.summary: MPRIS player tile with cover art, waveform seekbar, controls and synced lyrics from lrclib — the illogical-impulse media widget.

items.name: mjw-notes
items.summary: Flip card with a scrollable note pad and inline editing, autosaved to the plugin's own state — the illogical-impulse notes.

items.name: mjw-resources
items.summary: CPU, memory, disk and battery gauges read live from /proc, /sys and UPower — the illogical-impulse resources card.

items.name: mjw-sticker
items.summary: Rotatable sticker tile with outline colour, drop-replaceable — the illogical-impulse sticker.

items.name: mjw-text
items.summary: Floating desktop text in eight bundled handwriting fonts with inline editing — the illogical-impulse custom text.

items.name: mjw-timer
items.summary: Pomodoro, stopwatch and countdown on one tile with ring progress and desktop alerts — the illogical-impulse timers.

items.name: mjw-todo
items.summary: Flip card with a checkable task list, progress ring and inline add — the illogical-impulse todo.

items.name: mjw-usercard
items.summary: Greeting card with your name, host, uptime and weather quip plus lock, settings and session buttons — the illogical-impulse user card.

items.name: mjw-visualizer
items.summary: Live audio spectrum with five styles — bars, mirror, aurora, ring and dots — driven by your own playback stream.

items.name: mjw-weather
items.summary: Weather card with condition art, humidity, wind, visibility and sun times, fed by the Ryoku weather daemon (same data as the bar).

items.name: mjw-worldclock
items.summary: Up to four analog clocks for timezones you pick, with live UTC offsets — the illogical-impulse world clock.

items.name: mjw-battery
items.summary: Battery charge level and charging state with a vector icon badge and progress bar, read from /sys.

items.name: mjw-calc
items.summary: Material-style desktop calculator with a safe expression evaluator.

items.name: mjw-clipboard
items.summary: A rolling clipboard history read from wl-paste; click an entry to copy it back with wl-copy.

items.name: mjw-crypto
items.summary: Live BTC / ETH / SOL prices with 24h change and a sparkline, polled from the CoinGecko API.

items.name: mjw-git-dashboard
items.summary: Shows the branch, dirty-file count, and last commit of the git repository in your home directory.

items.name: mjw-habits
items.summary: Weekly habit tracker with streak counts and a seven-day matrix, saved locally.

items.name: mjw-network
items.summary: Live Wi-Fi status, local IP, and up/down throughput with an activity sparkline.

items.name: mjw-ping
items.summary: Live latency monitor with a jitter sparkline, pinging Cloudflare and Google DNS.

items.name: mjw-storage-map
items.summary: Root filesystem usage with a segmented bar and a used and free breakdown, read from df.

items.name: mjw-thermal
items.summary: CPU package temperature with per-core bars and a live status tag, from the kernel thermal zone and lm_sensors.
